items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: And I brought, that's how I met Nose. The first Monday night he stayed, he went to Baton Rouge with us.

ctx.x: Yeah. a lot of them big names that came in town, not only in New Orleans, but all the surrounding area. So you could hold the hill with book things, Senator Frank, Frank would book things, Senator Tom Couch, you know, so it was like around, and Frank had a nightclub plus a hotel. So the entertainer would come in town and play for him, and they would most likely stay in this hotel for nothing. So people had the chance to follow. As an example, Jan Brown came in town before he got big, he stayed at the Dew Drop…
Is that why they called you Nose?
